definitions: Continuing in the same way; and similar things; and others of the same kind.
Used to indicate that a list or pattern continues indefinitely or with similar items.
examples: She talked about her trip to Paris, the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and so on.
The recipe calls for flour, sugar, eggs, and so on.
He listed his hobbies: reading, hiking, playing guitar, and so on.
